map.title: V3 Step 3 Agent-Readable Feature Map
map.scope: Work Universe, evidence workspace and review output
map.sourceBoundary: Current v3.1 Step 3 implementation only; no Step 3 behaviour redesign.

relatedMaps.contract: Step 1a may enter Step 3 from a selected role title when no source posting is selected.
Step 2 passes the selected posting object, including source description and responsibilities, into Step 3.

implementationCommit.role: Source evidence baseline inspected for current Step 3 behaviour.
verifiedBy: source inspection of v3.1/src/ReviewStudio.jsx and v3.1/src/work-universe

deploymentStatus.notes: This documentation branch does not change deployment configuration. Deployment status is kept separate from browser and physical-runtime evidence.

physicalRuntimeVerification.notes: The map includes deterministic Chromium evidence, not a physical-device production verification.

screens.title: Clean and Full Review print package

features.name: Three-panel Work Universe shell
features.description: Step 3 opens with source evidence on the left, a guided centre canvas and a scrollable Contents/detail rail on the right.

features.name: Five canonical graphs and fifteen signals
features.description: The expanded Work Universe renders Labour, Organisation Work, Intelligence, Human-Agent and Transition as five parallel projections, each with exactly three first-order signals.

features.name: Source, lineage and claim disclosure
features.description: Job-ad rows, derived work units and lineage preserve source identifiers, methods, provenance and claim boundaries; selecting evidence highlights only linked graph paths.

features.name: Role, organisation and person projections
features.description: The same evidence can be reprojected around the target role, supplied organisation evidence or user-confirmed person evidence without promoting absent facts into claims.

features.name: Embedded Role Graph
features.description: The Labour graph opens the preserved Role Graph inside the centre panel with its layered, knowledge and SSOC modes available.

features.name: Evidence workspace round trip
features.description: Graph or evidence intent opens the preserved Review Studio workspace and returns to Work Universe with the relevant state available.

features.name: Evidence-gated specialised maps
features.description: Organisation, Workflow and Value Stream maps render only supplied structures and relationships; unsupported or missing sequences, hierarchy, timing, waste and maturity remain withheld.

features.name: Governance ledger and reviewer disagreement
features.description: Supplied governance records and competing reviewer positions remain separated from deterministic results, with incomplete controls and conflicts visibly withheld.

features.name: Clean and Full Review print package
features.description: Step 3 provides Clean and Full Review routes, printable A4 output, candidate actions, interview questions and evidence-gated resume rationale.

features.name: Responsive panels and contextual FAB
features.description: Desktop panels own their overflow; tablet and phone layouts preserve graph readability and use one contextual FAB to move among Workspace, Contents and Job Ad surfaces.

states.name: Guided start
states.description: Work Units and evidence verification lead before the user expands the full map.

states.name: Expanded five-graph map
states.description: All five canonical graph cards and their first-order signals are visible.

states.name: Graph, signal or evidence detail
states.description: The right inspector exposes source, method, derivation and boundary for the selected claim.

states.name: Embedded Role Graph
states.description: Role Graph is mounted in the centre panel while the Work Universe shell remains available.

states.name: Review Studio workspace
states.description: Structured graph or evidence intent opens the advanced evidence workspace.

states.name: Evidence withheld
states.description: Missing source, person, organisation, authority, access, workflow or governance evidence remains visibly WITHHELD.

states.name: Print package
states.description: Clean or Full Review output is prepared for browser print and A4 PDF.

transitions.name: Enter Step 3
transitions.from: Step 1a role selection or Step 2 selected posting
transitions.description: The preserved analysis path resolves into Work Universe with the available role and posting payload.

transitions.name: Explore full map
transitions.description: The user deliberately expands the guided start into all five canonical graphs.

transitions.name: Inspect graph or signal
transitions.description: Selecting a graph or signal opens its method, provenance and evidence boundary.

transitions.name: Select source evidence
transitions.description: Selecting a source row highlights linked graphs and exposes the same evidence identifier in detail.

transitions.name: Open Role Graph
transitions.description: The Labour graph opens the preserved embedded Role Graph.

transitions.name: Open evidence workspace
transitions.description: Structured graph, signal and evidence intent enters Review Studio.

transitions.name: Return to Work Universe
transitions.description: The workspace return action restores the Work Universe surface.

transitions.name: Open Print / PDF
transitions.description: The command bar opens Clean or Full Review printable output.

payloadFields.name: Role analysis result
payloadFields.absenceBehaviour: Render only available role anchor data and visibly withhold unsupported graph signals.

payloadFields.name: Selected posting and source rows
payloadFields.source: Step 2 selected posting or direct role-analysis input
payloadFields.absenceBehaviour: Keep the role-title route available, label source-derived sections honestly and return WITHHELD_NO_SOURCE_ROWS for evidence round-trip coverage.

payloadFields.name: Session-only person evidence
payloadFields.source: User-confirmed manual paste and selected target skills
payloadFields.absenceBehaviour: Person capability, access, authority and skill delta remain WITHHELD; raw text is not promoted into a claim.

payloadFields.name: Supplied organisation and process evidence
payloadFields.source: Explicit organisationMap, workflowMap and valueStreamMap payload fields
payloadFields.absenceBehaviour: Do not infer hierarchy, reporting lines, workflow sequence, timing, waste, savings, maturity or autonomous action from a job posting.

payloadFields.name: Governance and disagreement records
payloadFields.source: Explicit supplied governance ledger and reviewer positions
payloadFields.absenceBehaviour: Governance decisions and disagreement remain WITHHELD; session actions do not invent actors or timestamps.

invariants.statement: Exactly five canonical graph cards render and each contains exactly three first-order signals.
DOM controls and measured geometry remain authoritative; the R3F scene is a pointer-free visual enhancement.
Missing source, person, organisation, authority, access, workflow and governance evidence is visibly withheld rather than inferred.
Source evidence retains stable identifiers and graph links through detail and workspace navigation.
The Labour graph preserves the embedded Role Graph and its workspace action.
Role Graph/FAB and evidence-workspace navigation can return to Work Universe without losing the mapped surface.
Desktop panels own overflow and phone navigation exposes one logical panel at a time through the contextual FAB.
Clean and Full Review routes remain available and generated PDF output is non-empty A4 with evidence-gated content.
Feature-map work does not alter Step 1, Step 2, v3/ or Railway configuration.

responsiveProfiles.name: Desktop workbench
responsiveProfiles.contract: Three panels fit the available viewport and source, Contents and detail own vertical overflow.

responsiveProfiles.name: Phone workbench
responsiveProfiles.contract: Canonical graphs remain legible and the contextual FAB switches among Workspace, Contents and Job Ad without horizontal overflow.

evidenceRefs.description: Work Universe, workspace and print routing.
Canonical graph, evidence, projection, panel and FAB implementation.
Organisation Map surface; browser gate also covers WorkflowMap and ValueStreamMap withholding.
Clean and Full Review printable output.
Deterministic Chromium journey covering Step 3 geometry, graphs, evidence, specialised maps, governance, print and round trips.
Current implementation-to-blueprint status and honest remaining gaps.

gaps.description: No physical-device production verification is claimed by this map.
Review Studio has the full source/confidence/time-window footer contract; Work Universe does not expose a time-window value.
Session-only person evidence and printable set difference exist; a structured source-linked candidate proof ledger remains unbuilt.
Full split, merge, relabel, escalate and first-class withhold editing verbs are not built.

categories.basis: Role Graph, workspace, FAB and return paths are executable.
